name: Kamikawa (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Kamikawa town emblem in green: concentric outlined rings enclosing two stylised mountain peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 29 July 1955.

features.role: Kamikawa town emblem — concentric outlined rings enclosing two stylised mountain peaks
